body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics revealed ''VM-DC560’, 26X optical zoom digital camcorder during KES 2006. It adapted 1.1 mega pixel CCD, 2.7-inch wide LCD and dual layer record which allows twice more recording time.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
